name: Kiwi Capital
description: Investing in your future, on and off the track.
story: Kiwi Capital is a New Zealand-based investment firm dedicated to supporting local talent and innovation. Motorsports embodies the drive and precision we value, and we see it as a perfect platform to showcase our commitment to performance. We're looking for a team that reflects our values of hard work, determination, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.
